title: Grayton Beach "Absolutely Grayton" 309 Defuniak Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Private pool **Pool heating is available for $30 per day**- 6 adult bikes- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Grill area- Screened-in porch- Flat-screen TVs in every bedroom- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: This home is "Absolutely Grayt!" With a private pool, multiple screened-in porches and scenic forest views from every bedroom, guests certainly have an outdoor oasis that is perfect for entertaining. It accommodates 14 guests in 5 bedrooms and has 5.5 bathrooms. The main level of the home has a bright, open living area with modern decor, floor-to-ceiling windows, flat-screen TV and access to a veranda overlooking the pool deck. The screened-in porch has plentiful seating with lounge chairs and a separate dining area. A gourmet kitchen features stainless-steel appliances, granite countertops, seating for 3 at the bar and 8 at the dining table. There is a laundry room and 2 bedrooms down the hall, both with king beds and private, en-suite bathrooms. 2 additional bedrooms and a primary suite are upstairs with easy access to an additional living area and balcony. This balcony has beautiful horizon views of the forest and lounge chairs. The primary bedroom has a king bed, en suite bathroom and gorgeous views. There is also a separate living area connected to the primary bedroom and accessible by the second-floor porch. The first guest room has a king bed with it's own private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The second has 2 full over full bunk beds with it's own private bathroom and shower as well. Outside, enjoy use of the private pool and grill area that is perfect for cookouts! 6 bikes can entertain the kids while adults enjoy a moment of serenity in the swing by the pool. This home is just a short walk to a public beach access, the Grayton General Store and world-class restaurants and shopping. Don't miss your chance to book this home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):SECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower only-Guest Bedroom: Two Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Additional Living Area: Queen Sleeper SofaEvents are allowed at this home with prior approval.
